name: com.spacexploration/listings
title: SPACEXPLORATION
description: Free commercial real estate listings for sale and lease. Search with no account; brokers list free.

tools.name: get_registry
tools.description: Returns the full attribute registry — every searchable and filterable field, its type, allowed values, and display label. Read this first to understand the schema before calling search_listings with attribute filters.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search commercial real estate listings. Returns paginated hits with facet counts; every hit carries the public `url` to cite and its `listed_at` / `updated_at` stamps. For AI-driven search, call interpret_search first to convert a natural-language query into structured filters, then pass those filters — and its bounds, when present — here.

query.description: Free-text search query (street address, city, or keyword). Omit or pass null for no text filter.

filters.description: Structured filter map keyed by Typesense field name. Ranges as {min?, max?}, multi-select as string[], booleans as true/false. Call get_registry to see valid field names and allowed values.

sort.description: Sort key. Valid values from get_registry sort_options (e.g. "listed_at:desc", "price:asc").

bounds.description: Geographic bounding box (degrees) limiting hits to an area. Forward the bounds returned by interpret_search verbatim to honour "near <place>" intent; omit for a nationwide search.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Retrieve the full details of a single listing by its hashid. Returns the complete ListingResource projection including parcel data, all attribute details, and attachments: photos, plus the public documents the broker attached (brochures, offering memoranda, site plans) with their filename and a direct download URL. Broker contact is included only when the requesting user is authorised to manage the listing; such a user also gets every lease suite with its id and status, the rows update_listing takes back. parcel.lot_size is always in square feet; lot_size_unit only names the unit the lister typed it in (58370 with "acres" is 58,370 square feet, about 1.34 acres).

hashid.description: The short hashid of the listing (e.g. "a1b2c3d4"). Found in listing URLs and search hits.

tools.name: interpret_search
tools.description: Translate a natural-language property-search sentence into a structured filter payload compatible with search_listings. Use this as a transparent intermediate step: pass the user's raw query here, then forward the returned filters — and the returned bounds, when present (they carry the "near <place>" intent) — to search_listings.

prompt.description: A natural-language property search sentence from the end user. Example: "industrial with rail access in Denver under $5m".

tools.name: look_up_parcel
tools.description: Look up any US building by its street address and get the public data SPACEXPLORATION keeps on it, whether or not it is for sale or lease: the FEMA flood zone and natural hazard risk, EPA records nearby (including leaking underground storage tanks), Census demographics around it, access and nearby amenities, and, for a building that has been listed on SPACEXPLORATION, the county public record (owner, assessed and market values, taxes, tax lots, recorded sales) with a numbered source for each figure. Also returns the building page URL to share and any live listings in it (pass a listing hashid to get_listing). The first lookup of a building gathers its data in the background, which takes a minute or two: while status.gathering or status.researching_county_record is true, check on it with get_parcel and the returned hashid instead of repeating the lookup. Requires a signed-in account.

address.description: A full US street address with its street number, e.g. "910 Elysian Fields Ave, New Orleans, LA 70117". A road, a town or a partial address is refused: the lookup has to name one building.

tools.name: get_parcel
tools.description: Read a building SPACEXPLORATION already has, by the hashid that look_up_parcel returns or that a building page URL (/parcel/{hashid}/...) contains. Returns the same data as look_up_parcel: the address and building page URL, the FEMA flood zone and natural hazard risk, EPA records nearby, Census demographics, access and nearby amenities, the county public record with numbered sources where research has found it, and any live listings in it. It looks nothing up and starts nothing, so use it to check on a building whose status.gathering or status.researching_county_record was true.

hashid.description: The building's short hashid (e.g. "k3m9x2qa"), as returned by look_up_parcel in parcel.hashid.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save the current search as a named alert. The user will receive email digests when new matching listings appear. Requires authentication.

name.description: A human-readable name for the saved search. If omitted, a name is derived from the filters.

query.description: The free-text query string, if any.

filters.description: The structured filter map to persist (same shape as search_listings filters).

bounds.description: Geographic bounding box (degrees) the alert is limited to. Forward the bounds returned by interpret_search verbatim for a "near <place>" search; omit to alert on matching listings anywhere.

tools.name: list_my_saved_searches
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved searches, including their filters and alert schedule. Requires authentication.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Delete a saved search by its ID. Only the owner may delete their own searches. Requires authentication.

id.description: The numeric ID of the saved search to delete (from list_my_saved_searches).

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List all listings owned or brokered by the authenticated user, under `listings`, each with its status, price, views over the last 30 days, public `url` (live listings only) and `editor_url`. Optionally filter by status. Requires authentication. Shows the user a panel where they can change a price, publish a draft or take a live listing off the market.

status.description: Filter by listing status. Omit to return all statuses.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Geocode a free-form US address into coordinates and structured components (street_address, city, county, state, postal_code) plus a formatted address and place_id — exactly the identity fields create_listing requires. Use this first, then pass the result straight into create_listing instead of supplying your own coordinates.

address.description: Free-form address to geocode, e.g. "3763 Imperial St, Frederick, CO 80516".

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a new draft listing. Returns the full created listing exactly as stored, including its hashid and status. Pass an idempotency_key (any client-generated string, e.g. a UUID) to make the call safe to retry — re-sending the same key returns the original listing instead of creating a duplicate.

property_type.description: Property type. Allowed values are listed under the property_type attribute returned by get_registry (e.g. industrial, office, retail, land).

unit.description: Unit or suite number, if applicable.

formatted_address.description: Full formatted address string from geocoder.

apn.description: The county assessor parcel number (APN / parcel ID), if known. Used with the county to find the building if another listing already has it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-generated key (e.g. a UUID) making this create safe to retry: re-sending the same key within 24 hours returns the originally created listing instead of a duplicate.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Update a listing's parcel, pricing, or marketing data, or a lease's suites. Pass at least one group (parcel, pricing, marketing, spaces); send each group whole, not just the changed field. A live listing must stay publishable: an update that leaves it without what publishing required is refused whole, so switch a live listing between sale and lease in one call that carries the new side's price (sale_price, or spaces). Returns the full updated listing exactly as stored.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to update.

parcel.description: Parcel/address fields to update: street_address, city, county, state, postal_code, latitude, longitude, and optionally unit, lot_size (INTEGER SQUARE FEET — convert acres × 43,560), lot_size_unit (the unit the size was stated in: sqft | acres | sqm | hectares; display-only), year_built, property_type, place_id (from geocode_address — when the address moves, it matches the listing to a building already on file).

pricing.description: Pricing fields to update: listing_type (sale|lease). For a sale set sale_price (dollars), or omit it and set price_on_request=true for "price upon request". A lease is priced per suite (see spaces); lease_rate_period (per_sqft_year|per_sqft_month|per_month|per_year, default per_sqft_year) is the basis every suite's rate is quoted in. A lease with at most one suite, such as a whole building leased as one, can instead be priced here: lease_rate and available_sqft (INTEGER SQUARE FEET), or price_on_request=true, set that one suite, creating it when there is none. Optionally expires_at (ISO date).

marketing.description: Marketing copy to update: headline, summary, title_override, highlights (string[]).

spaces.description: A lease's suites, as the whole list: a suite left out is removed, and an empty list removes them all. A whole building leased as one is a single suite. To change suites, start from the spaces get_listing returns to you as the owner: a suite sent with its id is updated, and any field it leaves out keeps its stored value; a suite without an id is added. Publishing a lease needs at least one available suite with available_sqft and a lease_rate or price_on_request=true.

id.description: The suite's id, as get_listing returns it to you as the owner. Omit to add a suite.

available_sqft.description: Available space in INTEGER SQUARE FEET.

lease_rate.description: Asking rate in the listing's lease_rate_period basis, e.g. 24.5 for $24.50/SF/yr. Null when quoted on request.

lease_type.description: How operating expenses are split: nnn, fsg (full service gross), mg (modified gross), or gross.

space_type.description: Use of the space: a value from the space_type attribute get_registry returns.

available_date.description: ISO date the suite is available from.

min_term_months.description: Shortest lease term offered, in months.

max_term_months.description: Longest lease term offered, in months.

status.description: available (a new suite's default), pending, or leased. Only available suites are shown and priced.

price_on_request.description: true when the rate is quoted on request.

tools.name: set_listing_attributes
tools.description: Set broker-authored attributes on a listing you own. Pass `attributes` as a map of registry field name to value (the field names get_registry returns, e.g. {"attr_parking_spaces": 40, "attr_office_class": "Class A"}). Only fields get_registry marks "writable":true can be set; publish-time computed fields and hot columns (use update_listing for those) are rejected with guidance. Enum fields take the allowed value (or an array for multiselect); send null to clear a field (a live listing refuses to clear one publishing requires). Returns the full updated listing.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to update.

attributes.description: Map of registry field name to value, e.g. {"attr_parking_spaces": 40, "attr_office_class": "Class A", "attr_industrial_rail_access": true}. Only fields get_registry marks "writable":true are accepted. Multiselect enum fields take an array of allowed values. Send null to clear a field.

tools.name: attach_listing_photo
tools.description: Attach a photo to a listing you own directly from its public URL — one call, no separate sign/upload/confirm. The server fetches the image and ingests it with auto-generated thumbnail/hero/full variants. Only https image URLs whose host is publicly routable are accepted. The photo is content-moderated (must be real-estate related and safe) before it can appear publicly — the returned snapshot includes the moderation_status (approved / rejected / escalated) and moderation_reason. A rejected or escalated photo will not be publicly visible and will block publishing until removed or replaced.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to attach the photo to.

source_url.description: Public https URL of the image to fetch and attach. Must point directly at an image (jpeg, png, webp, gif, heic/heif) on a publicly-routable host.

tools.name: sign_attachment_upload
tools.description: Begin an out-of-band file upload. Returns a presigned R2 PUT URL and the headers to use; the file bytes are uploaded directly to storage, never through this channel. After PUTting the file, call confirm_attachment_upload with the returned attachment_id. Supports listings (photos, documents), users (avatar), and pages (cover, photos). Avatars pass an automated content check before they appear publicly.

attachable_type.description: Morph alias of the resource to attach to: "listing", "user", or "page".

attachable_id.description: Identifier of the attachable resource. For "listing" pass the listing hashid (e.g. "d5yqqgoa") — the same id every read tool returns. For "user" pass "me" to attach to yourself. For "page" pass its numeric id.

filename.description: Original filename including extension, e.g. "front-elevation.jpg". Used to derive the storage key and extension.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. "image/jpeg" or "application/pdf". Must match the collection whitelist.

size.description: Exact byte size of the file. Verified against the uploaded object at confirm time, so it must be accurate.

collection.description: Optional explicit collection: "photos", "documents", "avatar", or "cover". Omit to auto-route by MIME (images→photos, PDFs→documents; documents are PDF only). Singleton slots (avatar/cover) must be set explicitly.

tools.name: confirm_attachment_upload
tools.description: Finalize an out-of-band upload after the file bytes have been PUT to the presigned URL. Verifies the stored object matches what was signed (size and content-type) and marks the attachment ready. Returns the attachment snapshot with its public variant URLs. Idempotent: confirming an already-confirmed upload returns the same snapshot.

attachment_id.description: The attachment_id (ULID) returned by sign_attachment_upload. Confirm only after the file bytes have been successfully PUT to the presigned URL.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment you own by its ULID. Soft-deletes the row so it no longer appears on the listing. Use this to clean up an abandoned upload (one you signed but never finished) or a photo you no longer want. Idempotent: deleting an already-deleted attachment succeeds. A live listing keeps at least one approved photo: to replace its last one, attach the new photo first, then delete the old.

attachment_id.description: The attachment_id (ULID) of the attachment to delete, as returned by sign_attachment_upload / confirm_attachment_upload or listed in get_listing.

tools.name: publish_listing
tools.description: Kick off the publish pipeline for a draft listing. Enriches with AI, gathers market data, then transitions the listing to Active. Returns the pipeline ID to track progress, plus `suggestions` — non-blocking fixes (a flyer as the cover photo, a placeholder address, an unusual cap rate) to pass on to the user. Fails with the unmet readiness checklist if the listing is not ready. When photos hold it back, `photos_to_review` lists each one with its reason, and `owner_can_keep` marks a photo held only for an MLS or listings-site watermark: ask the user whether they own or have the rights to it, and if so send them to `editor_url` to confirm it there, since only they can.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to publish.

tools.name: get_publish_status
tools.description: Get the status of your listing publishes. Pass a listing hashid for the detailed status of that listing's latest publish run — overall state (pending/running/completed/failed), current phase, per-step progress, and any failure reason. Omit the hashid to list your recent publish runs across all your listings. Use this to track a publish_listing call to completion.

hashid.description: Optional. Hashid of a listing to get its latest publish run in detail. Omit to list your recent publish runs across all your listings.

tools.name: withdraw_listing
tools.description: Withdraw a listing, removing it from public search. This is a terminal status — the listing cannot be re-activated; create a new listing instead.

hashid.description: Hashid of the listing to withdraw.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to the questions people ask about SPACEXPLORATION itself: what it costs, listing a property, where leads go, finding property, AI assistants (including the built-in one), where the building data comes from, and accounts. Call this before answering any question about how SPACEXPLORATION works or what it costs, answer from what it returns, and link the entry's `url` (or its `see` page when it has no url). Pass `topic` to read one group; leave it out for all of them.

topic.description: One group of questions to read. Leave it out to get every group.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: File feedback or a support ticket with the SPACEXPLORATION team: a bug report, feature request, or question about the app or this MCP server. Works anonymously — include a contact email if you want a reply.

message.description: The feedback itself — what happened, or what should change about the app or the MCP server. Plain text, max 5000 characters.

category.description: What kind of feedback this is. Defaults to "other".

email.description: Optional contact email if you or your human want a reply. Authenticated callers default to their account email.
